flagged.comment: Adjoining land uses not documented on all sides. South side shows 'Single Family' use without specific property identification. West side (Valley View Road street frontage) does not identify land uses across the street. East and north sides are labeled but incomplete documentation of all surrounding properties on all four sides.

Adjoining land uses not labeled on the main site plan for north and south adjacent properties. Sheet 9 shows zoning for north but does not indicate land use, and south property has no zoning or land use designation. Main site plan must document all adjacent uses on all four sides.

Land uses for properties across adjacent streets and rights-of-way are not shown. Location map (Sheet 1) shows only street network. Site plan (Sheet 9) does not depict land uses across Valley View Road or other adjacent streets.

Land uses for properties across Valley View Road (west of the public right-of-way) are not documented on the site plan. Properties on the opposite side of the street should have their land uses identified and labeled.

Adjacent property zoning district designations not shown on all sides. South side property is labeled with 'Use: Single Family' but no zoning designation is provided for this adjacent property. Zoning must be shown for all surrounding properties to verify compatibility requirements.
Adjacent property zoning designation not shown on main site plan for south property. East and north adjacent zoning are labeled on Sheet 9, but south property has no zoning designation displayed.

Adjacent zoning designations shown on site plan cannot be verified against current City GIS records. North property shown as 'MF-2-CO' but facts.md indicates adjacent SF-3 parcel (ID 0406100210). East side properties shown as 'MF-2-CO' with 'Claerain Ridge Condominiums' labeling. Zoning accuracy requires independent GIS confirmation.

Discrepancy exists between sheet documentation: Sheet 9 shows north zoning as MF-4-CO while Sheet 11 shows MF-2-CO. Cannot verify accuracy against City GIS records. Confirm correct zoning designation.

Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet may not be completely shown. East side shows existing apartment buildings in dashed outline with annotations ('Existing 4-Story Brick Apt. Bldg.' height 45'-10"). North and south sides show no building footprints, but it is unclear whether buildings exist on these adjacent properties and are simply not depicted or whether no buildings exist. Documentation is incomplete or ambiguous.

Building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet are not clearly confirmed on main site plan for north and south sides. East side footprints are shown, but north and south adjacent building footprints are not clearly depicted on Sheet 9.

Required note absent when no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. North and south adjacent properties are shown without building footprints, but the site plan does not include the required notation: 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet.' If buildings exist on these properties, they must be depicted; if not, a required clarifying note must be added.

Verification note absent stating whether buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. Site plan must include note for each side where no buildings exist stating 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet.'

Exterior lighting above the second floor is not verified to be absent where facing adjacent residential property. Sheet 9 notes state that 'All site lighting to be located on the building will be in compliance with Subchapter E 2.5 and will be reviewed during building plan review.' Individual luminaire locations and orientations above the second floor are not shown on the site plan. Compliance cannot be verified from submitted site plan; requires architectural/building elevation review.

Documentation does not explicitly restrict exterior lighting above the second floor when facing or adjacent to residential properties. Provide note or detail confirming above-2nd-floor lighting restriction for locations adjacent to residential uses.

Mechanical equipment noise level not demonstrated. No mechanical equipment schedule or noise specifications (dB(A)) at property lines adjacent to residential uses are provided on the site plan. Requirement applies to all sites with mechanical equipment adjacent to residential: noise may not exceed 70 dB(A) at the property line. Compliance cannot be verified without equipment schedule and noise ratings.

Mechanical equipment noise level specifications not documented. No equipment schedule with manufacturer dB(A) ratings provided to demonstrate compliance with 70 dB(A) limit at property line adjacent to residential uses. Provide mechanical equipment schedule with noise ratings.

Zoning designations not included on mylars. Sheet 2 (Plat) is the historical Mecey Subdivision recorded plat (1975) and does not include current zoning information. No current zoning notation is evident on the mylar/plat documents.

Dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle location not identified on site plan to verify 20-foot setback from properties zoned or used as SF-5 or more restrictive (LA, RR, SF-1, SF-2, SF-3, SF-4A, SF-4B, SF-5). Sheet 9 references trash collection requirements but does not depict the location of refuse receptacles on the site plan drawing. Compliance cannot be verified.

Residential parking (88 spaces: 10 surface + 78 garage) screening requirements cannot be fully verified. East adjacent property is zoned/used as Multi-Family (MF-2-CO residential). If this parking abuts the adjacent residential property, a wall, fence, or landscape screen at least 6 feet in height is required (LDC § 25-6-563(B)). Site plan shows wooden privacy fence on east side (H.6) but the HEIGHT of this fence is not specified on either the landscape plan or site plan. Compliance cannot be verified without fence height documentation.

Adjacent land uses not labeled on site plan. The SF-3 property to the south (which triggers compatibility standards per facts.md) is not identified with any land use designation. While zoning is labeled for north (MF-4-CO) and east (MF-2-CO) adjacent properties, the south property has no land use label.

Vacant adjoining property not identified as vacant on site plan. The south adjacent property shows no building footprints or structures on the drawing and appears to be vacant, but is not labeled with the required notation 'VACANT'.

Adjacent property zoning designation not shown on site plan. The south adjacent property (identified in facts.md as SF-3 parcel 0406100210 triggering Subchapter F compatibility standards) has no zoning label. While MF-4-CO is labeled to the north and MF-2-CO to the east, the critical SF-3 designation is absent from the south property.

Zoning district boundary not shown or labeled for all adjacent zones. The site abuts MF-2, MF-4-CO, MF-2-CO, and SF-3 zoning districts. While north (MF-4-CO) and east (MF-2-CO) are labeled, the SF-3 zone boundary to the south is not shown or labeled.
areas: Site boundaries abut multiple zoning districts

flagged.comment: Zoning designations on mylars cannot be verified. Mylar documents are not available in the submitted project files; review of mylar compliance with zoning designation requirements cannot be completed without access to these documents.

Existing building footprints on adjoining properties within 50 feet not shown on site plan. The east adjacent property shows 'Existing Apartment Building' labeled and depicted. However, the north adjacent property (MF-4-CO zoning) shows no building footprints within the 50-foot vicinity, though buildings likely exist on this multi-family parcel; footprints must be shown if they are within 50 feet of the site boundary.
areas: North adjacent property; possibly other sides

flagged.comment: Required note absent when no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet. The south adjacent property shows no structures on the site plan and appears to be vacant. If no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet, the site plan must include a note stating 'no buildings exist on adjoining lots within 50 feet'. This note is not present.

Verification of building dimension callouts on site plan cannot be completed. Tabular building data (gross floor area, coverage, heights) is provided in tables on Sheet 9, but specific dimension callouts (length × width) on the actual drawing itself cannot be verified from the available documentation. Dimension callouts must be shown on the drawing, not only in tables.

Continuous perimeter boundary lines including roofline and attached canopies cannot be verified. The site plan drawing shows building layouts and outlines, but the specific requirement for a complete continuous perimeter boundary line that includes roofline and any attached canopies cannot be confirmed from the available documentation; detailed examination of the drawing would be required.

Exterior lighting above the second floor restriction not explicitly stated on site plan. The plan includes a note requiring full cut-off and shielding per Subchapter E 2.5, but does not explicitly state the General Site Plan Notes requirement that exterior lighting above the second floor is prohibited when adjacent to residential property. This restriction must be explicitly documented.
areas: All sides of site (surrounded by residential zoning: MF-2, MF-3, MF-4, SF-3)

flagged.comment: Mechanical equipment noise specifications not found in submitted documentation. No mechanical equipment schedule or manufacturer specifications demonstrating noise levels at or below 70 dB(A) at the property line adjacent to residential uses are available in the reviewed site plan sheets.
